definition: A complex fused reproductive structure formed by the anatomical union of staminal anthers and the central stigmatic head.

structural_components.corona: Whorl of 5 hoods (cucullus) surrounding the column, often housing internal curved horns (cornu).
structural_components.stigmatic_chamber: Vertical guide slits between rigid anther wings where insect tarsal claws catch.
structural_components.pollinarium: Pair of waxy pollen sacs (pollinia) linked via translator arms to a central dark locking clip (corpusculum).

field_photo_protocol.horizontal_profile: Eye-level macro with top of corona showing hood-to-column height ratio.
field_photo_protocol.internal_hood: Top-down lighting inside hood cavity to resolve presence/absence of internal horn.
